How Much CBD Should I Take?

When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated.

You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you.

settings.title: How do CBD Energy Supplements enhance energy levels?
settings.text: CBD energy supplements may enhance energy levels by potentially interacting with receptors in the body's endocannabinoid system to promote balance and reduce fatigue. CBD's potential anti-inflammatory and stress-reducing properties may contribute to increased energy. However, individual responses may vary, and more research is needed to fully understand CBD's impact on energy levels.

settings.title: Can CBD Energy Supplements replace my morning coffee?
settings.text: CBD energy supplements can be a potential alternative to morning coffee for some individuals. CBD's potential energy-boosting properties, combined with its potential ability to promote focus and reduce anxiety, may offer a different kind of energy without the jitters or crash associated with caffeine. However, personal preferences and requirements may differ, and it's always advisable to consult with a healthcare professional.

settings.title: Are there any side effects to CBD Energy Supplements?
settings.text: CBD energy supplements are generally well-tolerated, but some individuals may experience mild side effects like dry mouth, drowsiness, or changes in appetite. These effects are typically minimal and temporary. Choosing high-quality products from reputable brands like NextEvo Naturals and following recommended dosages can help minimize potential side effects.

settings.title: How quickly will I feel more energized after taking a CBD Energy Supplement?
settings.text: The time it takes to feel more energized after taking a CBD energy supplement can vary. Factors such as individual metabolism, dosage, and overall health can influence the timeline. Some individuals may experience an energy boost relatively quickly, while others may require more time for CBD to build up in their system. Consistency and patience are key when integrating CBD energy supplements into your routine.

settings.title: Can CBD Energy Supplements help with workout endurance?
settings.text: CBD energy supplements may potentially help with workout endurance due to CBD's potential anti-inflammatory properties and ability to reduce exercise-induced stress and discomfort. By potentially promoting overall balance in the body and supporting recovery, CBD may contribute to improved endurance. However, more research is needed in this area. It's always recommended to consult with a healthcare professional to determine the best approach for your individual needs and fitness goals.

settings.title: Which CBD Product is Right for Me?
settings.text: There are a variety of CBD products available and finding the right one for you will depend on your preferred method of ingestion. Our CBD products are available as CBD capsules, CBD edibles and CBD gummies, so if taking pills isn’t to your taste, you can have an easier option. You’ll also need to consider your motivation for using our CBD products (supporting sleep, alleviating anxiety etc) as well as the strength of the product.
